users.title: Members
users.selfRoles: These are your own roles. You can't give yourself more than you hold, and the last administrator stays.
users.unitsOnUnits: Units are changed on the Organization structure pages, where a membership has its role and dates.

remove.title: Remove {{email}}?
remove.description: Their membership here ends: they are signed out of this workspace and lose its roles. Their account and other workspaces stay. You can restore their access later.

impersonate.title: Act as {{email}}?
impersonate.description: Your session becomes theirs for a limited time, and everything you do is recorded as you acting as them. Stop from the banner to get your own session back.

users.readOnly: You can see this member. Changing their roles, units or access needs the permission to manage members.

explain.title: Explain access
explain.description: Why this member may or may not do each action, as the permission checks decide it: pick what, and a record if you like. A record you can't read is not found; what a field hidden from you decides stays hidden.
explain.subject: What
explain.noGrant: No role of theirs grants this.

grants.hint: Each role may end at a date and time (temporary access); leave it empty for no end.
grants.untilPast: Pick a time in the future.

invitations.inviteDescription: They get an email with a link. Their membership, with these roles and units, starts when they accept.

fields.name: Name (optional)
fields.nameHint: Only for a new account; its owner can change it.

invitations.resendDescription: The current link stops working and a new one is emailed. The roles, their end dates and the units stay as they were.
invitations.resent: A new link was sent to {{email}}.

roles.title: Roles & permissions

conflict.title: This role changed
conflict.description: Someone saved it since you opened it.

roles.builtIn: This role is built in: it can't be changed or deleted.
roles.unknown: These permissions are no longer offered and will be dropped when you save:
roles.deleteDescription_one: {{count}} person has it: they lose its permissions.
roles.deleteDescription_other: {{count}} people have it: they lose its permissions.

editor.hint: Tick what this role may do. A rule with conditions covers only the records that meet all of them; add another rule to cover more.
editor.notHeld: You don't hold this permission, so you can't grant it.
editor.everyRecord: Applies to every record. Tick conditions to narrow it:
editor.allOf: Applies only to records that meet all of:

units.title: Organization structure
units.dialogDescription: Moving a unit moves every unit under it. Members of a unit see what the units below it own ("in my units").

errors.nameTaken: A unit with this name already exists under the same parent.
errors.notEmpty: This unit still has units under it, members, records or saved views. Empty it first.
errors.managedByScim: Your identity provider manages this unit over SCIM: change it there.

units.deleteDescription: Only an empty unit can be deleted: no units under it, no members, no records and no saved views.
units.needsManageUsers: Adding, changing and removing members needs the permission to manage members.
units.removeDescription: They lose what this unit gives them. The membership ends and is kept as history.

impact.none: No one would gain or lose access through their units.
impact.some: Who would gain or lose access through their units:
impact.truncated: More people could be affected: only the first 500 were compared.
